**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) via the in-repo `filter` engine — `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:15` `Engine`, `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `schema.go`, `render.go`). Mechanism: `Engine.Compile` parses/type-checks the CEL expression against a schema into a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then `renderer.Render` (`internal/filter/render.go:33`, dialect switch at `:231-234`) emits dialect-specific SQL plus bind args via `RenderOptions{Dialect: DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL}`; each driver appends it to its WHERE clause through `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`) — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`.

```

attachment      — deleted explicitly for the memo (store/memo.go:149-157)
```

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React bundle is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by an Echo static-file middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:41-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `middleware.StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); invoked from `server/server.go:71`.

```

webhook async dispatch workers — internal/webhook/webhook.go:41-52: 4 goroutines started by package init(),

```
Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` (cron-style scheduler: `scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) is **not** used by the server — the only importers are its own tests (`internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`, `example_test.go:10`).
- `server/runner/memopayload` has a `Runner`/`RunOnce` batch job (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-27`) that is never started; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.
